newsitem.title: USA: ICG Communications sets junk bond, pfd deal.
newsitem.headline: ICG Communications sets junk bond, pfd deal.

text.p: The following 144a private placement offering of high-yield bonds and exchangeable preferred stock from ICG Communications Inc was priced on Thursday via lead manager, Morgan Stanely & Co, according to market sources.

The company, which is based in Englewood, Colorado, is a national competitive local exchange carrier (CLEC). The company also provides network integration and support services as well as maritime telecommunications service
